phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Get through the first levels without losing much HP or CS.
Win or at least match the level 2 race: mid is the shortest lane, so level 2 comes after the first wave plus one melee minion of the second.
do: Push the first wave fast if your champion clears well: priority lets you help your jungler at the scuttle crab around 3:30.
Watch where the enemy jungler started; a mid gank can come from either side of the river as early as 2:30-3:15.
dont: Don't trade into a bigger minion wave: minions hit hard at levels 1-3.
Don't walk into a river brush you haven't warded: both sides can hide the jungler.
ifAhead: Zone them off the wave, crash it into their tower and look at the river: your jungler may be fighting for scuttle.
ifEven: Farm, trade only on their cooldowns, keep the wave near the middle or your side.
ifBehind: Let the wave come to you and farm near your tower. Don't contest CS in their damage range.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Keep the CS lead or close the gap.
Keep priority: the lane that pushes first can move first.
do: Ward one side of the river and keep the other side in mind: hug the warded side.
Use the jungler's shown position (kill feed, map) to decide when to push.
Recall on a crashed wave with enough gold for a component.
dont: Don't roam if your wave is pushing into your tower: you lose the wave and maybe your tower plates.
Don't chase kills into the river without vision.
ifAhead: Crash the wave, then look for a roam to a side lane or a fight at the first dragon.
ifEven: Short trades when their main ability is down; keep the wave even.
ifBehind: Farm near your tower; wait for level 6 and your first item.

phases.label: Level 6 -> first item
goals: Use level 6: your ultimate often decides a fight in mid or in a side lane.
do: Track the enemy's ultimate: many mid laners roam or all-in with it.
Push before dragon and grubs so you can move first; mid has the shortest walk to both.
Ping your side lanes when your opponent leaves lane.
dont: Don't fight a level 6 opponent without your own ultimate.
Don't let your opponent roam for free: push their wave in and follow, or ping it.
ifAhead: Roam bot or top after a crashed wave, or take plates while your opponent is gone.
ifEven: Farm to your item; fight only on clear windows.
ifBehind: Stay safe: clear waves under tower, don't give more gold, follow your opponent's roams late rather than never.

phases.label: First item -> 14:00
goals: Turn your first item into plates, grubs, Herald or a dragon.
Be the first one at every fight near the river.
do: Push, then help your jungler at objectives.
Recall when a second component is affordable.
dont: Don't walk into the enemy jungle without vision while their jungler is unseen.
ifAhead: Pressure the mid turret: a fallen mid turret opens the whole map.
ifEven: Match your opponent's movements; don't lose the wave.
ifBehind: Clear the wave first, then join fights late with your team instead of losing more alone.

phases.label: Mid game
goals: Be where the next objective is: mid can reach both sides fastest.
do: Clear the mid wave, then catch a side wave on the side of the next objective.
Group for dragon and Baron when your team calls it.
Ward the jungle entrances on the side of the next objective.
dont: Don't farm a far side lane while four enemies start an objective.
ifAhead: Take the mid turret and force fights around objectives.
ifEven: Farm safe side waves near your team and group for objectives.
ifBehind: Stay with your team, clear waves under your towers, look for picks on your side.

phases.label: Late game
goals: One fight decides the game: don't get caught before it.
do: Arrive at objectives first and together.
Know your job in the fight (burst, zone or peel) before it starts.
dont: Don't farm a side lane alone while Baron or Elder is up.
Death timers are long: a pick can lose the game.
ifAhead: Siege with your team; take Baron after a won fight.
ifEven: Wait for their mistake; keep vision around the next objective.
ifBehind: Defend with your team, clear waves, look for a pick near your side.

trading: Trade when your opponent uses their main ability or walks up for a last hit.
Trade with your minion wave, not into theirs.
Walk out of a trade before their cooldowns are back.
waveManagement: Crash the wave before you recall or roam so you lose no CS.
Push before objectives so you can move first: priority in mid decides who gets to the river.
When behind, let the wave push to you and farm near your tower.

when: After laning, catch side waves near your team, on the side of the next objective.
rules: Don't go past the river in a side lane without vision.
Leave when two enemies are missing from the map.
tpUsage: If you took Teleport, keep it for fights at objectives.

teamfight.role: Depends on your champion: burst, zone or peel.
rules: Don't go first into full crowd control unless you're the engage.
Stay with your team before objectives.
targetPriority: The closest threat you can reach safely, then their carries.

objectives: Dragon at 5:00, Voidgrubs at 8:00, Rift Herald at 15:00, Baron at 20:00.
Mid has the shortest walk to dragon and the grubs: push your wave first and be there before them.
commonMistakes: Roaming while your wave pushes into your tower.
Walking into an unwarded river brush.
Fighting before your first item against a strong early opponent.
Farming a far side lane while the enemy starts Baron or Soul.

enemy_laner_dead: Shove the wave into their turret and take plates, roam to a side lane, or recall with the gold you have.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river before you push next time, and check where their jungler last showed.
you_died_solo: Don't fight them again until you have an item or level advantage; farm safely.
opp_level_lead: Don't fight until you catch up in levels.
you_level_lead: Short power window: trade now if their cooldowns are down.
you_hit_level_2_first: Trade right away before they hit level 2 as well.
you_hit_6: Look for a fight if your opponent isn't level 6 yet, or push and roam.
first_item_done: Your first spike: pressure the lane, roam or fight at objectives.
second_item_done: Two items: look for fights and objectives.
three_items_done: Full spike: force objectives with your team.
you_are_fed: Take towers and objectives; don't throw the lead with risky deaths.
you_are_behind: Farm safely and scale; don't take even fights.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't 1v1 them; play with your team.
enemy_team_numbers_down: Take the biggest objective that fits before they respawn.
baron_up_soon: Push your wave now so you can be at Baron in time.
dragon_up_soon: Push your wave now so you can move to dragon first.
grubs_soon: Push your wave and help with the grubs.
herald_soon: Push your wave and help with Herald.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Ward both sides of the river and play near your tower until your jungler can cover you.
long_death_timers: A death now can lose the game: don't get caught alone.
turret_lost: Play near your next turret and watch for dives.
enemy_turret_taken: Move to the next objective or rotate.
